name: sqt-reverse-engineering-mcp
description: Adds the REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) MCP server, pinned to rea-agents 6.5.0, for evidence-backed reverse engineering of native binaries, Electron and JavaScript apps, Android packages, firmware and captures. Tools that run the target or change a device always ask first. Authorized targets only. Pairs with software-company reverse-engineering for .NET and file triage.
